classification.recommended_terminology: primitive Padé row-content obstruction at base 3/2
classification.terminology_boundary: Primitive, content, common factor, denominator clearing, and normalization are established algebraic and Padé vocabulary. The combined obstruction label is descriptive and was not located as a standard theorem name.
nearest_prior_work: Coussement and Smet (2009) construct rational-parameter Lambert-series Padé approximants with explicit integrality factors and discuss common divisors; this is the closest methodological precedent for treating clearing and content as quantitative arithmetic data.
Zudilin (2016) studies irrationality measures for a generalized q-logarithm at integer q-base and rational parameters using Padé-type arithmetic, providing an adjacent construction setting.
Neither source states the exact endpoint-unit exclusion of the primes 2 and 3 at homogeneous evaluation (3,2), nor the card's combined local no-go.
classification.attribution: Describe the scaling and congruence steps as elementary. Attribute the exact Lean API, the base-(3,2) composition, and the explicit residual-route interface to the local source; cite the Padé papers only for the surrounding integrality/content framework.
classification.mathematical_interest: Low standalone depth but real methodological value: it distinguishes removable projective row scale from primitive residual arithmetic and closes a tempting false source of local gain.
classification.reusable_scope: Integral approximation rows under common scaling, especially homogeneous rational-base evaluations whose endpoint coefficients are units modulo the numerator and denominator primes.
classification.why_it_matters: A construction cannot claim improved error-versus-determinant economics merely by inserting common row factors, and at base 3/2 the endpoint-unit hypotheses prevent those factors from supplying either required base prime. Subsequent work must inspect the primitive determinant or change the integral model.

mechanism_comparison.projective_core: Multiplying a row (U,V) by c leaves the rational quotient V/U unchanged where defined and multiplies the linear error by c; scaling two rows multiplies their exterior determinant by c_n c_m.
mechanism_comparison.local_core: At homogeneous evaluation (3,2), reduction modulo 2 isolates the top coefficient and reduction modulo 3 isolates the constant coefficient up to a unit. Unit endpoints therefore exclude the two base primes from a common divisor.
mechanism_comparison.literature_relation: The literature confirms that clearing factors and common divisors are standard quantitative features of Padé irrationality constructions. The card's endpoint test is a much more local elementary congruence, not a consequence attributed to either paper.
mechanism_comparison.exact_delta: A single Lean-checked interface turns these elementary facts into a falsifiable route test and names the residual arithmetic that remains after primitive normalization.
mechanism_comparison.semantic_consolidation: The abstract homogeneous endpoint theorem, the source-cone endpoint calculation, the q-Apéry denominator specialization, and the primitive-content synthesis are proof layers and consumers of one mechanism. They must not be counted or narrated as four independent discoveries.
